opening.argument: The video explains the birthday reward as a membership benefit redeemed in store: membership is free, and a customer can receive the drink after staff swipe or look up the Starbucks card. The customer-service page likewise describes redeeming an earned or Birthday Reward with a card or mobile app and a barista. The speaker also offers free samples through a description link and asks viewers to provide a shipping destination. That offer warrants a limit on what can be concluded: the supplied material does not establish who operates the destination, what information is collected beyond the requested shipping destination, whether samples were delivered, or any deceptive mechanism. The birthday explanation remains an ordinary customer-benefit account.
